subject: general
question: Which Indian think tank organised the 2025 World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS)?

options.text: National Institution for Transforming India (NITI) Aayog

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Energy and Resource Institute (TERI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS)** is an annual flagship event organized by **The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI)**.
 
• The WSDS is a global platform that brings together heads of state, policymakers, industry leaders, and academicians to deliberate on pressing environmental and sustainability issues such as **climate change**, **energy efficiency**, and **environmental conservation**.
 
• The summit typically focuses on addressing challenges related to sustainable development and finding practical solutions to ensure a sustainable future for the planet.
 
• The WSDS 2025 would continue its legacy of fostering global collaboration to combat climate change while promoting economic growth and sustainable development.
 
• TERI, headquartered in **New Delhi**, has a history of working on research and advocacy concerning energy, environment, and sustainable development since its establishment in **1974**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Energy and Resource Institute (TERI):**

 
 
• TERI was established in **1974** and focuses on research in the fields of energy, environment, and sustainable development.
 
• It is headquartered in **New Delhi, India**, and has played a pivotal role in addressing global and local environmental challenges.
 
• TERI organizes various initiatives, including the annual WSDS, to promote dialogue and action on global sustainability issues.
 
 
 
• **World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS):**
 
 
• The WSDS was started by TERI in **2001** and has since become one of the most prominent sustainability events globally.
 
• The summit focuses on topics such as **climate resilience**, **renewable energy**, **green technology**, and **sustainable urbanization**.
 
• It serves as a platform for multi-stakeholder discussions to address policy issues and solutions for sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Other Organizations Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Centre for Science and Environment (CSE):** A public interest research and advocacy organization based in India, focusing on sustainable development issues and environmental research.
 
• **National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog):** The premier policy think tank of the Indian government, aimed at fostering cooperative federalism and sustainable development.
 
• **Research and Information System (RIS):** A New Delhi-based autonomous policy research institute specializing in international economic development, trade, and investment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of WSDS:**

 
 
• WSDS encourages global cooperation in addressing climate and sustainability challenges.
 
• The summit facilitates policy dialogues and partnerships among nations, industries, and research organizations.
 
• It contributes to the achievement of global sustainability goals, including the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
 
 
• **Key Themes of Previous WSDS:**
 
 
• **2019:** 'Attaining the 2030 Agenda: Delivering on Our Promise.'
 
• **2020:** 'Towards 2030 Goals: Making the Decade Count.'
 
• **2021:** 'Redefining Our Common Future: Safe and Secure Environment for All.'
 
 
 
• **Role of TERI in Global Sustainability:**
 
 
• TERI's efforts include promoting **renewable energy**, **energy efficiency**, and **climate policy research**.
 
• Its initiatives contribute towards achieving **environmental conservation** and combating **climate change**.
